# `assets/import/GltfSceneImporter.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/import/GltfSceneImporter.js`

engine/assets/import/GltfSceneImporter.js — full glTF/GLB scene → EngineModel.  glTF is the preferred runtime delivery format (nodes, meshes, materials, skins, animations, buffers, textures). This importer parses the whole scene graph — not just motion — reusing the engine's accessor toolkit (core/math/MeshAttributeMath) to decode vertex/index data exactly. Materials and textures are preserved as raw blocks here and normalized in Phase 2; the original look must always be recoverable.

### `extractGltfMaterialPayload(json, buffers = [], externalImages = null)`

Extract the recoverable glTF material/texture payload from already-resolved buffers. This is shared by the full asset pipeline and the editor mesh importer so both paths normalize exactly the same source records.

### `async importGltf(data, opts = {})`

Import a glTF/GLB into an EngineModel.

**Parameters:**

- `data` *(Uint8Array|ArrayBuffer|object)* — GLB bytes, or a parsed gltf object
- `[opts]` *(object)* — { name, bin, readExternal }

**Returns:** EngineModel
